$meta.name: CivicDataSpace Design Tokens
$meta.description: Canonical, machine-readable source of truth for CivicDataSpace design tokens. All values here were audited from the implemented tokens in src/index.css — nothing was invented, and no proposed/unimplemented values (dark mode, secondary→amber remap, etc.) are included. The Tailwind v4 theme in src/generated/tokens.css is GENERATED from this file via `npm run gen:tokens`; do not hand-edit that file. design-system.md is also generated from this file.

color.$description: Base + brand + semantic color roles. Each key K produces the CSS custom property --K (kebab-cased) in :root and the Tailwind utility color --color-K via @theme inline.

chart.$description: Categorical data-viz palette. Key N produces --chart-N and --color-chart-N.

sidebar.$description: Sidebar surface scope. `DEFAULT` produces --sidebar / --color-sidebar; other keys produce --sidebar-<key> / --color-sidebar-<key>.

surface.$description: App-chrome surfaces that sit outside the shadcn base set. Key K produces --<kebab(K)> and --color-<kebab(K)>.

font.$description: Font stacks. Key K produces --font-K in :root and the Tailwind --font-K theme key.

radius.$description: Border-radius scale. `DEFAULT` produces the --radius base custom property only (no Tailwind key, matching current implementation). sm/md/lg/xl produce --radius-<key> in :root and the Tailwind --radius-<key> theme key, and are expressed relative to --radius so the scale stays proportional.
